name.label: Instance name
name.help: Shown in the UI, in outgoing emails and backup metadata.

frontendUrl.label: Public URL
frontendUrl.help: Base URL used for invitation links and password-reset emails. Leave empty to auto-detect from the request URL.

publicUrl.label: Public URL (device pairing)
publicUrl.help: Externally reachable address of this instance, used for the device-pairing QR code so the mobile app can connect from outside the LAN. Leave empty to auto-detect from the request URL.

lanUrl.label: Internal URL (LAN)
lanUrl.help: Optional local address of this instance for devices on the same network (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3010).

maxUsers.label: Maximum users
maxUsers.help: Hard cap on the number of accounts. Recommended 1–10 for small groups.

allowRegistration.label: Allow public registration
allowRegistration.help: When enabled, new users can register without an invitation link (not recommended).

betaFeatures.label: Show beta features
betaFeatures.help: Reveals unfinished features for everyone on this instance. For testing only — beta features may change or disappear again.
betaFeatures.listEmpty: Nothing is behind the switch at the moment.
betaFeatures.listNote: This list is read from the registry in the source, so it always matches what this build actually gates.

devicePairing.name: Device pairing
devicePairing.what: The Devices settings entry and its QR code, the only way to bind the phone app to this account.

roadtrips.name: Roadtrips and tours
roadtrips.what: The “Roadtrips” domain (multi-day trips with stations at your stays) and all tours: the tours page and editor, the tour tab on the dashboard and on a trip, the tours on the overview map, and the routing provider and Strava cards.

travPlan.name: TravPlan (alpha)
travPlan.what: The planning mode for a trip still ahead: day plan, ideas, booking import, transfers, packing list, budget and the handover to the travel log. Alpha experiment: may still change fundamentally.

cruiseTracks.name: Recorded tracks on cruises
cruiseTracks.what: The “Recorded tracks” section on a cruise’s page: a GPS recording (a file or Dawarich) replaces the computed sea route of the legs it covers – on the map and in the statistics.

comparison.name: Friend comparisons
comparison.what: Compare your travel totals with friends who agreed, as a leaderboard — no individual records.

encryptedShare.name: Encrypted sharing
encryptedShare.what: Send full travel records, encrypted on your device, to verified friends — not yet independently reviewed.

federatedTripSharing.name: Trip sharing across servers
federatedTripSharing.what: Connect with companions on other TravStats servers by invitation code, under Settings → Trips; it has its own switch under server connections as well. Shared trips travel signed to the companion's server. With the switch off, this server does not answer other servers for it at all.

travTrack.name: TravTrack (own location history)
travTrack.what: An own location history on this server: positions come from the Companion app, GPX files, OwnTracks, Overland and a Dawarich import, flights and trips included, with privacy zones and delete by time span. Also needs the TravTrack switch under Instance.

countryThreshold.label: A country counts from …
countryThreshold.help: The starting point for this instance, so a fresh account does not have to decide anything. Anyone may override it in their own settings — “does a connection count?” is a personal definition, not a property of the server.

passkeys.title: Passkeys (WebAuthn)
passkeys.statusUsable: Passkeys are usable on this instance.

status.notConfigured: Not set up yet — add at least one origin below.
status.insecureOrigin: Not usable: the first origin is not HTTPS. Only localhost is exempt.
status.invalidRpId: Not usable: the passkey domain is not a valid domain.

rpId.label: Passkey domain
rpId.help: The bare domain only — no https:// and no port. Leave empty to derive it from the first origin. NOTE: a passkey is bound to this value forever; changing it later breaks every passkey already registered.

origins.label: Allowed origins
origins.help: One per line, with scheme and port if any. The first one is authoritative. Several only make sense when they share the same passkey domain (e.g. app.example.com and www.example.com).

webdav.title: WebDAV sync
webdav.subtitle: Mirror backups to a remote WebDAV share (Nextcloud, HiDrive, …).

enabled.label: Enable WebDAV sync
enabled.help: After each successful backup the archive is uploaded to the remote share.

url.label: WebDAV URL
url.help: Full URL up to your user root, e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/abrechen2/

password.label: Password
password.help: Stored encrypted at rest (AES-GCM). For Nextcloud use an app password.

backupPath.label: Remote backup path
backupPath.help: Subfolder on the WebDAV share where backups are stored.

success.title: Invitation created

airlineLogos.title: Airline logos

logging.title: Debug Logging & Diagnostics
logging.description: Controls the logging behavior of the system. Debug mode enables detailed output for troubleshooting.

help.levels: error → warn → info → debug → trace (from least to most detailed)

level.label: Log Level
level.hint: Higher levels include all lower levels (e.g., Debug includes Info, Warn, Error)
level.pinned: Pinned to “{{level}}” by the LOG_LEVEL environment variable. The setting here is saved but takes effect only once LOG_LEVEL is removed.

retention.label: Log Retention (Days)
retention.hint: Log files older than this are deleted automatically every day and at startup.

http.label: Log HTTP Requests
http.hint: Log every HTTP request with its path (without query string), status, duration and IP (category: http)

database.label: Log Database Queries
database.hint: Log SQL queries with args and performance metrics (category: database)

parser.label: Log Parser Operations

parserSettings.title: Global Parser Configuration
parserSettings.description: Default parsers for all users. Local ones are free; cloud AI costs per request and needs a key.

llmSwitch.title: AI model
llmSwitch.label: Use the AI model (reading bookings and trip summaries)
llmSwitch.hint: Off: TravStats asks no language model at all – not even when an Ollama URL is entered above or OLLAMA_URL is set. Bookings are then read with the built-in templates only.

ollama.title: Ollama LLM Parser
ollama.description: Ollama runs locally or on your network and analyzes booking confirmations with an LLM. Ideal for multi-stop and complex emails. Always tried first when a URL is set — no consent needed within your network.

remoteOptIn.label: I agree that booking data is sent to this address if it is outside my network.

pull.title: Download a model
pull.failed: The model could not be downloaded. Check the name and that Ollama is reachable.

order.label: Who reads first?
order.hint: Applies to flights, stays, cruises and places alike. Measured 2026-09-17 on 31 flight mails: the templates read every one in under a second, the language model took 19 minutes and missed three. "AI first" is worth it when no template covers your senders.

provider.title: AI provider
provider.description: Who reads the bookings no template knows? Ollama always goes first when it is configured. If it does not answer, TravStats asks the cloud providers that are switched on below, in order. Switching on, key, model and consent are set under External services; only the order is set here.

chain.title: Cloud provider priority
chain.hint: If Ollama does not answer (not configured, or not reachable), TravStats tries these providers in order — but only the ones with BOTH a key AND consent. A provider missing either is skipped, never tried. A provider that answers ends the chain — even with a thin answer.

errors.unreachable: The provider is not reachable. Check the URL and the network.

consent.title: Send bookings to OpenAI
consent.warning: Your booking mails are sent to OpenAI's servers (USA) — up to 12,000 characters of the email or PDF, for every booking no template knows, including names, booking numbers, travel dates and prices. What OpenAI does with it is governed by its own terms, not by TravStats.
consent.label: I agree that this data is sent to OpenAI.
consent.inactive: OpenAI is configured but not yet consented to — without consent, OpenAI is never asked.

consent.title: Send bookings to Anthropic
consent.warning: Your booking mails are sent to Anthropic's servers (USA) — up to 12,000 characters of the email or PDF, for every booking no template knows, including names, booking numbers, travel dates and prices. What Anthropic does with it is governed by its own terms, not by TravStats.
consent.label: I agree that this data is sent to Anthropic.
consent.inactive: Anthropic is configured but not yet consented to — without consent, Anthropic is never asked.

consent.title: Send bookings to Google
consent.warning: Your booking mails are sent to Google's servers (USA) — up to 12,000 characters of the email or PDF, for every booking no template knows, including names, booking numbers, travel dates and prices. What Google does with it is governed by its own terms, not by TravStats.
consent.label: I agree that this data is sent to Google.
consent.inactive: Google is configured but not yet consented to — without consent, Google is never asked.

custom.name: Custom provider (OpenAI-compatible)
custom.hint: Your own server or a cloud service with an OpenAI-compatible interface — OpenRouter, Ollama Cloud, a LAN vLLM/LM Studio.

consent.title: Send bookings to this provider
consent.warning: If this provider is outside your network, TravStats sends it the text of the email or PDF (up to 12,000 characters) for every booking no template knows — including names, booking numbers, travel dates and prices. What the provider does with it is governed by its terms, not by TravStats.
consent.label: I agree that this data is sent to this provider.
consent.inactive: The saved provider is outside your network. Until you agree, this provider stays out of the chain.

schedule.description: Scheduled backups run at 02:00 in the zone chosen below – daily, on Sundays or on the 1st of the month, depending on the interval.
schedule.loadFailed: The backup settings could not be loaded. Saving is disabled so nothing gets overwritten.

toasts.outcomeUnknown: The server no longer reports the outcome — check the backup list before trying again.

failure.BACKUP_TOOL_MISSING: The backup tool (pg_dump, psql or tar) is not installed on the server. The official Docker image ships it — on your own installation, please install the PostgreSQL client tools.
failure.BACKUP_DISK_FULL: The backup drive is full. Delete old backups or enlarge the volume.
failure.BACKUP_PERMISSION_DENIED: The server may not read or write the backup directory. Please check the permissions of the data volume.
failure.BACKUP_DB_UNREACHABLE: The backup tool cannot reach the database. Please check that the database is running and the connection settings are right.
failure.BACKUP_TOOL_VERSION_MISMATCH: pg_dump is older than the database server. Please update the PostgreSQL client tools to the server's version.
failure.BACKUP_FAILED: The backup failed. The cause is in the server log.
failure.RESTORE_FAILED: The restore failed. The cause is in the server log.
failure.BACKUP_INTERRUPTED: The backup was cut off because the server restarted or a restore was applied. Simply start it again.

cloudFailure.WEBDAV_BACKUP_AUTH: The WebDAV server rejected the credentials. Check the user name and password in the WebDAV settings.

cloudFailure.WEBDAV_BACKUP_EXISTS: This backup is already in the backup list.

fxCdn.title: Exchange rates
fxCdn.label: Fetch rates for currencies the ECB does not publish from cdn.jsdelivr.net
fxCdn.description: The ECB publishes 30 currencies. With this off, exactly those stay convertible; everything else is stored and shown but marked “no rate” and left out of totals. With it on, this instance asks the free jsDelivr dataset for the rest — only for rates the ECB lacks, and without a key.

loginBackgrounds.title: Sign-in page images
loginBackgrounds.subtitle: Photographs that drift across the left half of the sign-in page. With none of your own, the five shipped ones run.
loginBackgrounds.publicWarning: Anyone who can reach this instance sees these, signed in or not. Only upload photographs that may be public.
loginBackgrounds.empty: No images of your own yet — the sign-in page shows the five that ship with TravStats.
loginBackgrounds.replacesShipped: Your images replace the shipped ones entirely. Remove them all to go back to the shipped set.

reResolve.title: Re-resolve time zones

reResolve.noChanges: No time zone would change. There is nothing to apply.
reResolve.truncated: {{shown}} of {{total}} changes shown. All {{total}} are applied.

confirm.message_other: {{count}} entries get the new zone from the dry run. Their local time shifts by the difference shown; the stored instants stay.

reResolve.applied: Applied: {{applied}} · Skipped because changed since the dry run: {{skipped}}

federation.title: Server connections
federation.description: Connect this server to other TravStats servers so people can compare across servers. Only totals travel, signed but not end-to-end encrypted.
federation.envNote: Set by environment variables (FEDERATION_*). Change it there.
federation.enabledSub: Without this, comparing stays on this server.
federation.originHint: https, no port or path — the way other servers reach it.
federation.tripSharingSub: People on trusted servers can share trips with accounts on this server. The facts of a shared trip travel signed over TLS to the companion's server; private fields never do. Takes effect only with a key and beta features switched on.
federation.fingerprint: Fingerprint — give it to the other server's admin through a second channel (e.g. a phone call):
federation.peerKey: Public key of the other server
federation.peerFingerprintHint: Compare it with the one the other admin told you.

rotateConfirm.title: Replace the server key?
rotateConfirm.message: Other servers that pinned your previous key will no longer accept your new signatures. The affected comparisons and shared trips may stop working until their admins have checked and pinned your new key. The keys of other servers you have pinned stay valid.

federation.rotatedHint: New key generated. Download the connection file again and send it to the admins of the connected servers.
federation.qrHint: Scan the code with the other admin's Companion app. Then compare the fingerprint above with the other server's admin before confirming the server. The code contains no secret and does not expire. It is only good for the saved key and the saved address: after a key change or a new address, the other admin has to scan it again.
federation.downloadHint: Send it to the other server's admin. It contains no secret.
federation.downloadOriginPending: Save the changed address first – the file names the saved one.
federation.importHint: The ZIP or JSON file the other admin sent you. Nothing is pinned until you press “Pin server”.

admissions.title: Requests from other servers

direction.incoming: This server wants to connect to you (it presented an invitation from here).
direction.outgoing: Someone here wants to connect to this server.

admissions.fingerprint: Fingerprint – compare it with the other server's admin over a second channel:
admissions.tripSharingNote: Approving lets people on both servers compare their numbers. Requests to share trips become possible once the switch "Share trips with other servers" is on.
admissions.waitingForOther: waiting for the other server's admin
admissions.loadFailed: The requests from other servers could not be loaded. Reload the page.

federation.advancedHint: Connection file, QR code and pinning a server by hand. You rarely need this: invitation links put the request here by themselves.
federation.importedCompare: Compare the server address and the full fingerprint with the other admin over an independent channel, e.g. by phone.
federation.importedReplaces: You already pinned this server with a different key. Pinning this one replaces it – so check it with the other admin again. Previous fingerprint: {{fingerprint}}
federation.importedAlreadyStored: This server is already pinned with exactly this key. There is nothing to do.

error.COMPARISON_PEER_KEY_INVALID: The key and fingerprint do not match, or the key is not a valid Ed25519 key. Ask the other admin for both again. You cannot pin this server's own address.
error.COMPARISON_PEER_UNREACHABLE: The other server did not answer or refused our request. Check its address and that it has enabled connections on its side.
error.COMPARISON_PEER_UNKNOWN: You have not pinned this server. Reload the page and try again.
error.COMPARISON_FEDERATION_ENV: This server's identity comes from environment variables (FEDERATION_*) and cannot be changed here.
error.FEDERATION_ORIGIN_MISSING: This server has no public address yet. Enter the https address other servers reach it at, below.
error.FEDERATION_OFF: This server is not connected to other servers. Ask your admin.
error.FEDERATION_ADMISSION_DISABLED: This server is not connected to other servers. Ask your admin.
error.FEDERATION_ADMISSION_KEY_MISMATCH: This server's key does not match what is stored or named in the link. Compare the fingerprint with the other admin.
error.FEDERATION_ADMISSION_SUSPENDED: This server is suspended. Only an admin can re-enable it.
error.FEDERATION_ADMISSION_FULL: Too many requests to other servers are waiting. Wait until one is decided.
error.FEDERATION_ADMISSION_INVALID: That is not a valid invitation link. Ask for a new one.
error.FEDERATION_ADMISSION_UNREACHABLE: The other server is not answering right now. Try again later.
error.FEDERATION_ADMISSION_NOT_FOUND: That request no longer exists. Reload the page.
error.FEDERATION_ADMISSION_NOT_PENDING: That request has already been decided. Reload the page.
error.generic: That did not work. Check the details and try again.
error.refresh: Done, but the list could not be reloaded. Reload the page.
error.COMPARISON_FEDERATION_OFF: For a connection file this server needs a key and a saved public address.
error.COMPARISON_CONNECTION_FILE_UNREADABLE: This file is not a readable connection file. Use the ZIP file (or the JSON file inside it) the other server downloaded.
error.COMPARISON_CONNECTION_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large for a connection file (64 KB at most).
error.COMPARISON_CONNECTION_FILE_FORMAT: This is not a connection file in a format this server knows. One of the two servers may be out of date.
error.COMPARISON_CONNECTION_FILE_ORIGIN: The address in the file is invalid: it must start with https and hold no port, path or credentials (servers on your own network: environment variable FEDERATION_PRIVATE_PEERS).
error.COMPARISON_CONNECTION_FILE_KEY: The key in the file is not an Ed25519 public key.
error.COMPARISON_CONNECTION_FILE_FINGERPRINT: The fingerprint in the file does not match its key. The file is damaged or altered – ask for it again.
error.COMPARISON_CONNECTION_FILE_SELF: This is this server's own connection file. Import the other server's file.

importMode.title: Import mode
importMode.description: Lifts the quantity limits on uploads and imports, so a first import with all its documents is not blocked for hours. Lasts 24 hours and ends by itself. Demo protection and token permissions stay in place.
importMode.loadFailed: The import mode could not be loaded.
importMode.saveFailed: The import mode could not be saved. Please try again.

templateRepo.title: Template repository
templateRepo.description: Where the parser templates are synced from. Point it at your own copy of the template repository — a fork, or a self-hosted mirror — to use templates the official one does not have. The sync then reads every template from that URL; templates only the old repository named are withdrawn.

readsFrom.env: The sync reads from {{url}} (the server's TEMPLATE_REPO_BASE_URL).
readsFrom.default: The sync reads from the official repository {{url}}.

result.invalidUrl: That is not a usable URL.
result.httpsRequired: Plain http is allowed only to a host on your own network. Use https.
result.credentialsInUrl: The URL must not contain a user name or password — it is stored and shown in plain text.
result.unreachable: The repository could not be reached, or it has no index.json at that address.

operatorLogos.title: Open data for logos and pictures
operatorLogos.description: Logos of rail operators, coach companies, ferry lines and rental companies, and pictures of ships, car models and train categories on the map cards come from Wikidata and Wikimedia Commons – freely licensed files only, with their authors credited. The server asks, never the browser, and sends only the name of the company, ship, car model or train category. Switched off, the cards show monograms and no pictures.

travTrack.title: TravTrack
travTrack.description: The own location history: positions reach this server from the Companion app, GPX files, OwnTracks, Overland and a Dawarich import. Switching it off deletes nothing — accounts holding data keep their summary, export and delete.

travPlan.description: The planning mode: plan trips ahead and compare them on the way. Switching it off deletes no plans — they stay stored and reappear once TravPlan is switched on.

limits.title: Daily limits per account
limits.help: Requests, not cost: how many AI and weather lookups one account may trigger per UTC day.

aeroapi.title: FlightAware AeroAPI: plan and monthly budget
aeroapi.description: AeroAPI bills per result set. TravStats counts every call in the UTC calendar month and sends nothing once the budget is reached — never a surprise bill. The per-call costs are estimates until they are compared with a real invoice.
aeroapi.cost: Assumed cost per call: flight status {{flights}}, flight track {{track}} (unverified).
aeroapi.rateLimit: At most 10 result sets per minute; beyond that TravStats waits or falls back to other providers.
